219:t_007:6.en:
$$シン$$
(A society that implemented the $$デスティニープラン$$... Something like that...)

219:t_007:7.en:
$$モニカ$$
「To all units! A new force is approaching this area!」

219:t_007:8.en:
$$レド$$
「Is it $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ reinforcements...!?」

219:t_007:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That conjecture is incorrect.」

219:t_008:0.en:
$$レド$$
「We will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. We cannot allow them to live.」

219:t_008:2.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ told me... The $$人類銀河同盟$$, where $$レド$$ served, devoted everything to fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...」

219:t_008:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone born in the Alliance is raised as a soldier. Anyone who doesn't serve that purpose isn't allowed to live...」

219:t_008:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「For $$レド$$, fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is life itself...?」

219:t_008:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's awful... Having someone decide your entire way of life...」

219:t_008:6.en:
$$シン$$
(A society that implemented the $$デスティニープラン$$... Something like that...)

219:t_008:7.en:
$$モニカ$$
「To all units! A new force is approaching this area!」

219:t_008:8.en:
$$レド$$
「Is it $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ reinforcements...!?」

219:t_008:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That conjecture is incorrect.」

219:t_009:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But I've never seen that coloration before!」

219:t_009:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「A new species...!? Or a mutant!」

219:t_010:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$! They're heading toward our ship!」

219:t_010:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Could they be here to pick up $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan, since they're aboard!?」

219:t_011:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are attacking our ship!」

219:t_011:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn! Are these like that other swarm that came to Earth!?」

219:t_012:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「In the middle of the galaxy!?」

219:t_013:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「This is $$アンタレス$$ 1. I will now provide support.」

219:t_013:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$...! Is that you, $$ブレラ・スターン$$!?」

219:t_013:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「It's been a while, $$早乙女アルト$$. I never expected to meet you again here.」

219:t_013:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「We're in the middle of the damn galaxy...! This is way beyond a coincidence!」

219:t_013:7.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'll take it! Meeting someone we know in a strange place like this is reassuring!」

219:t_013:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I see. $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is here too...」

219:t_013:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Does that have something to do with why you're here?」

219:t_013:10.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「We'll talk later. First, we have to get through this.」

219:t_013:12.en:
$$カナリア$$
「$$ブレラ・スターン$$... He was a member of the old $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, and he's $$ランカ$$'s brother.」

219:t_013:13.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ランカ$$ has another big brother besides Major $$オズマ$$...!?」

219:t_013:14.en:
$$カナリア$$
「It's a complicated story. Ask $$オズマ$$ about it later.」

219:t_013:15.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! The $$バジュラ$$ and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ seem to regard each other as enemies!」

219:t_013:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it'll be a three-way battle.」

219:t_013:17.en:
$$レド$$
「If the monsters kill each other, all the better. We'll take advantage of that.」

219:t_013:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wait, $$レド$$! The $$バジュラ$$ aren't monsters!」

219:t_013:19.en:
$$レド$$
「If they attack us, it's all the same. In fact, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ fights them too.」

219:t_013:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Both of you, that's enough. Do you want to die here?」

219:t_013:25.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Concentrate on getting through this! Don't think about anything else!」

219:t_013:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ブレラ$$! $$ランカ$$ is aboard the $$クォーター$$ too!」

219:t_013:27.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I see. Then I have all the more reason to stay alive.」

219:t_013:29.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'll open a way through...! Let's go!」

219:t_014:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Just two days ago, we were on Earth. Now we're fighting monsters in a three-way battle, with stars we don't even know the names of beside us...」

219:t_014:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「What's... going to happen to us now...?」

219:t_014:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Let's think about that now.」

219:t_014:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm also concerned about the missing $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, and the $$ミスリル$$ and $$プリベンター$$ members who seem to have stayed on Earth.」

219:t_014:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I can't guarantee a way back to Earth, but we can ensure our safety for the time being.」

219:t_015:3.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$ミレーヌ$$! Is that really you, $$ミレーヌ$$!?」

219:t_015:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Reporting. The large-scale $$時空震動$$ after the $$再世戦争$$ transported me to the galactic center...」

219:t_015:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$マクロス７船団$$ rescued me and took me in.」

219:t_015:9.en:
$n
「The super long-range emigrant fleet where $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ lived, huh...」

219:t_016:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Don't tell me you're upset because the $$バジュラ$$ left! We're on the brink of life and death here...」
